Anukhaṇe.g: sacepi anudakaṁ udapānaṁ patto puriso udakaṁ apassanto kalalaṁ viyūhitvā anukhaṇeyya, tathāpi taṁ vāri kaddamagandhikaṁ bhaveyya, amanuññatāya na piveyya, tatheva vītasaddhaṁ payirupāsantena laddhapaccayāpi parittā ceva lūkhā ca, amanuññā aparibhogārahāti attho.
